hook.description: The Elder Nobleman thrusts his cane into Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
hook.evidence: The sudden, aggressive physical confrontation immediately establishes high stakes and power dynamics.

candidates.reason: This clip captures the inciting moment of the conspiracy to frame the protagonist.

hook.description: Rupert's wide-eyed, shocked reaction to the suggestion of a capital charge.
hook.evidence: The visceral reaction to a life-or-death threat hooks the viewer into the gravity of the situation.

candidates.reason: It highlights the cold, calculated decision to manufacture evidence for a death sentence.

hook.description: Catherine beaming with malicious satisfaction while spreading her red fan.
hook.evidence: The visual contrast of a beautiful woman expressing pure cruelty is a classic, effective hook for this genre.
